profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Laravel, Vue, SQL, Git
profile.summary:
As a Web Developer at Columbus State University, I contribute to enhancing university operations and improving the student experience through modern web technologies, including Laravel and Vue.js. Notable projects include the Tower Traditions web application, which increased student activity and garnered positive feedback from the Student Life department.  

Pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Columbus State University, expected December 2026, I leverage my skills in Laravel, Vue.js, and website updating to build responsive and visually appealing web solutions. My work reflects a commitment to creating efficient processes and accessible platforms that benefit students, faculty, and staff.

projects.title: Kaze Token Builder
projects.description:
An online playtable for creating MTG-like tokens, counters, and dice. Users can create an account and login, then quickly get started by navigating to the playtable and selecting presets or creating custom tokens. Power and Toughness counters on the tokens can be adjusted, the token can be "tapped" and deleted as necessary.
Additionally, users may navigate to a page of generic counters. More features to be added later.
